title: pssc dbg run|continue|step|next|out|start --json
description: Where a debug session's run is after a run command: stopped for the user (`stopped`: a breakpoint, a register watch, a step, a pause, a failing check...), ended (`exited`), or still running when `--timeout` ran out (`running`; the next run command or `pause` returns its stop). `output` is the logpoint lines written on the way. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

session.description: The session ID `pssc dbg start` returned.

reason.description: `start`: `pssc dbg back`/`rc` went back to the run's start.

tick.description: Statements the run has started so far (Python engine); `back`/`rc` run the run again to an earlier tick.

src_ref.description: Provenance entry of the statement (or instruction) stopped at; 0 when unknown.

hits.description: The engine's break or watch ids (before the session's filtering).

detail.description: Per reason: `step` {kind} (`back` after `pssc dbg back`); `watch` the access {rw, width, addr, data, reg_id?}; `check`/`sanitizer` the event's detail; `error` {severity, text} or {error}; `unimplemented` {name, fn_id, args}.

breakpoints.description: `breakpoint`: the user breakpoints that stopped the run.

watches.description: `watch`: the user watches that stopped the run.
